entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Split application and watch output testing #50873
  • Running multiple "dotnet watch run" with dependency overlap periodically fails #50869
  • [NETSDKE2E]Installing .NET 10 runtime-deps should depend libicu 76 rather than 78 or 77 on Debian 13 #50857

Closed

  • [WebToolsE2E][Hot Reload] Page does not update StyleSheet file when dotnet watch .NET 10.0 blazor web app with SDK 10.0 RC 2 in CLI. #50829
  • Make it possible to invoke the compiler directly #8742
  • EnableDynamicLoading does not work in netstandard2.0 library projects #50582
  • When installing 10.0 RC 1 SDK on non-ENU OS, the setup and installation completion page is not localized #50075
  • File-based apps are not packed/published in Release config by default like their project-based counterparts #50528
    10.0.1xx

PullRequests

Created

  • address Daniel's feedback #50876
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Add SelectRuntimeIdentifierSpecificItems MSBuild task for filtering items by compatible RuntimeIdentifier #50875
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 2795116 #50874
  • Add flag to silence sdk resolution warning #50871
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'main' #50868
  • add a repo-local telemetry doc and notification for folks that work on CLI Telemetry #50867
    documentation, Area-Telemetry
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Track mono aot in telemetry too #50864
    Document for new feature, Area-Telemetry
  • [StaticWebAssets] Fix recursive glob stem truncation for multi‑dot component JS module files and expand pattern coverage #50863
  • Fixup project reference paths during file-based app conversion #50860
    Area-run-file
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.3xx' => 'release/8.0.4xx' #50847
  • Dotnet watch browser refresh configurable port (#50629) #50846

Merged

  • Ensure that tool packages can still publish normally with `dotnet publish`. #50445
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Fix ASP.NET source generators for non-web projects with FrameworkReference #50872
  • Update xunit.v3 to 3.2.0-pre.10 #50856
  • Updating the minVS version shown in the installer UI #50762
  • Support CsWinRT 3.0 multi-targeting and WindowsSdkPackageMinimumRevision #50264
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix ASP.NET source generators for non-web projects with FrameworkReference #50662
  • Remove prune package data for .NET Framework #50816
